payload.text: Every host run books through Intent's slots on the desk after vc reads its bytes; the desk's holder is estate status's control line, READ IT RATHER THAN ASSUMING (agentic-engineering-vc since 10 Nov, devbin-vc before it, and it has changed under vc twice without notice); GO by name; START and END to the holder and vc; new bytes are a new booking, and a grant records only the lane, so a head that has moved since the ask is confirmed to the holder in the exchange that grants it.
